question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Flaunt
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e., **Hide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Flaunt"** means to display (something) ostentatiously, especially in order to provoke envy or admiration or to show defiance. (दिखावा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She likes to **flaunt **her wealth by wearing expensive jewelry.
 
 
 
• **"Hide"** means to conceal oneself or something from sight; prevent someone from being seen. (छिपाना)
 
 
• **Example: **He would **hide **his snacks in a drawer to keep them safe from his siblings.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Flaunt' **is **'Hide'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e., **Hide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wide** (चौड़ा): Having a larger extent from side to side than is usual or expected.

 
 
• **Example:** The river is very **wide **at this point.
 
 
 
• **Parade** (परेड ): A public procession, especially one celebrating a special day or event.
 
 
• **Example: **The **parade **for Independence Day was spectacular.
 
 
 
• **Open** (खुला): Not closed or fastened.
 
 
• **Example:** The door was left **open **accidentally.
